title: KoMultiText: Large-Scale Korean Text Dataset for Classifying Biased Speech in Real-World Online Services

bias_targets.methodology: Supervised multi-label text classification using fine-tuned Korean BERT-based models, evaluated via AUROC, F1-score, and PRROC on a manually annotated dataset of real-world online comments.
